name: 44 Trey Mafia
description: 44 Trey Mafia (TMF Bloods) is a Blood-affiliated street gang based in Detroit's northwest side, operating in the W. Eight Mile Road and Santa Barbara corridor. The set has longstanding ties to the 44 Skoni Skams clique and connections to Chicago's Glo Gang.

sources.title: Inside the History of Blood-Affiliated Groups in Detroit
